subject: literacy
concept: Developing a character with specific, believable traits rather than a generic description
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a character profile using trait cards (specific habits, fears, quirks) rather than generic adjectives
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a generic character description to a more specific, vivid rewrite
exercise.abstract: Student writes a short character description using specific, concrete details

misconception_flags: describes a character using only generic adjectives (nice, cool, mean) with no specific detail

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
